name: Mexico Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Mexico Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; plain golf carts only on designated roads, and never on US 98 or the state roads. Mexico Beach's ordinance sets its own cart rules.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
City golf cart rules; no carts on US 98

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on US 98 in Mexico Beach?
faq.a: No. Carts may only cross US 98.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Cape San Blas Road?
faq.a: Only where it's posted 35 mph or less; much of it is 45 to 55 mph.
